Description: Direct SQL injection via string concatenation with user-controlled coupon_code parameter in raw cursor.execute() call. Attacker can manipulate SQL query to bypass checks or extract data.
NoSQL injection via direct unmarshaling of user JSON input into bson.M filter object. Attacker can inject MongoDB operators like $ne to bypass coupon code validation.
Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) - User-controlled mechanic_api URL is directly used in requests.get() without validation. Attacker can make server fetch arbitrary URLs including internal services.
Command Injection - When enable_shell_injection is true conversion_params from database is concatenated into shell command without sanitization. User can inject commands via video update endpoint.
Short Title: OS Command Injection in Video Conversion

Description: JWT Algorithm Confusion Attack - Service accepts HS256 signed tokens and uses RSA public key as HMAC secret. Attacker with public key can forge valid tokens.
JWT JKU Header Injection - Service fetches JWKS from user-controlled JKU URL header allowing attacker to specify their own key for validation.
Unsigned JWT Acceptance - PlainJWT tokens without any signature are accepted as valid allowing complete token forgery.
JWT KID /dev/null bypass - When KID header points to /dev/null the service uses AA== as the secret which is easily guessable.
Log4j JNDI Injection - When ENABLE_LOG4J is true user-controlled email containing jndi: is logged via Log4j allowing remote code execution via Log4Shell.
BOLA - Vehicle location endpoint returns vehicle location owner email and name for any carId UUID without authorization check.
BOLA - Service request/mechanic report can be accessed by changing report_id parameter. No ownership verification is performed.
Mass Assignment - Order PUT endpoint allows user to set status to RETURNED triggering credit refund without actual return.
Mass Assignment - Video update endpoint allows setting conversion_params which enables command injection when video conversion is triggered.
Broken User Authentication - v2/check-otp endpoint has no rate limiting allowing unlimited OTP brute force attempts.
BFLA - Admin video delete endpoint /api/v2/admin/videos/{video_id} allows deleting any user's video without proper admin role verification.
JWT Token Validation Bypass - Dashboard API uses getUserFromTokenWithoutValidation which extracts claims without verifying signature.
LLM Prompt Injection - Chatbot has SQLDatabaseToolkit providing direct database access. Malicious prompts can extract data or perform unauthorized actions.
Excessive Data Exposure - Posts API exposes author's email vehicleID and profile picture URL in every post response.
Unauthenticated Access - Service requests can be fetched by VIN without any authentication check.
Unauthenticated Access - Order GET endpoint fetches order details without authentication decorator.
Denial of Service - Contact mechanic allows up to 100 request repeats in a tight loop causing resource exhaustion.
Excessive Data Exposure - Coupon validation returns full coupon details including amount for any matched query.
Potential Path Traversal - Download report endpoint uses filename from user input. Validation regex may be bypassed with encoded characters.
Short Title: Potential Path Traversal in Report Download

Description: CORS Misconfiguration - Access-Control-Allow-Origin is set to * allowing any origin to make authenticated requests.
Insecure TLS Configuration - HTTP client uses InsecureSkipVerify:true disabling certificate validation for inter-service communication.
Weak OTP - 4-digit numeric OTP is generated which has only 10000 possible combinations making brute force feasible.
